1	# tradeMonitor 运行与测试
     2	
     3	> 上级：[`docs/reference/INDEX.md`](INDEX.md)
     4	
     5	## 运行前提
     6	
     7	- Python 3.12、uv、Node.js 20+、npm。
     8	- Screening/Strategy 运行需要 Binance 公共网络；不需要 API key。
     9	- 默认配置：[`config/monitor.json`](../../config/monitor.json)，当前 schema 为 `trade-monitor.config.v2`。
    10	
    11	## 启动命令
    12	
    13	```bash
    14	uv sync --dev
    15	npm install
    16	uv run trade-monitor serve
    17	npm run dev
    18	```
    19	
    20	本地 API 默认 `http://127.0.0.1:8787`，Vite 默认 `http://127.0.0.1:5173`。`serve` 启动后立即执行一次 public screening，之后每 4h 重跑；Strategy 每 60s 读取 selection v2 并轮询 15m REST K 线。
    21	
    22	只读检查现有 local artifacts 时使用无后台模式；它不会启动 screening/Strategy loops：
    23	
    24	```bash
    25	uv run trade-monitor serve --no-background --port 8790
    26	```
    27	
    28	单次 public 调试命令会访问 Binance，必须确认任务授权边界：
    29	
    30	```bash
    31	uv run trade-monitor screen-once
    32	uv run trade-monitor strategy-once
    33	```
    34	
    35	## Config Migration
    36	
    37	```bash
    38	uv run trade-monitor config-migrate
    39	uv run trade-monitor config-rollback
    40	```
    41	
    42	Migration 首次运行会 exclusive-create `config/monitor.v1.backup.json` 和 `config/monitor.v1.backup.manifest.json`，重读校验 source bytes/digest/length 后才原子替换 active config。重复 migration 只校验既有 pair；路径、schema、digest、length 或 partial pair 冲突会停止。
    43	
    44	Rollback 同样要求 backup/manifest/active target 全部匹配，先 exclusive-create v2 rollback copy/manifest，再恢复 v1 bytes。Rollback 后当前 v2 binary 不能启动，不是日常切换命令。
    45	
    46	## Taxonomy Classifier
    47	
    48	显式入口是 repo-local `classify-binance-contracts` Pi skill。它只编排 structured CLI，不直接写 authority JSON：
    49	
    50	```bash
    51	uv run trade-monitor taxonomy snapshot --output /tmp/taxonomy-snapshot.json
    52	uv run trade-monitor taxonomy validate --draft /tmp/taxonomy-draft.json
    53	uv run trade-monitor taxonomy diff --draft /tmp/taxonomy-draft.json
    54	uv run trade-monitor taxonomy apply --draft /tmp/taxonomy-draft.json --expected-base-revision <sha256>
    55	```
    56	
    57	`snapshot` 是 public Binance/CCXT discovery，`apply` 是 authority mutation；两者都需要当前任务明确授权。`validate`/`diff` 是本地只读；`apply` 还要求 snapshot identity coverage、expected base revision 和 preserve-known/replace-unknown policy。Catalog 与 manual overrides 永不由 classifier 修改。
    58	
    59	## 可选验证命令
    60	
    61	按改动风险选择最小充分集合，不要求每个任务运行全部命令或遵循固定测试顺序：
    62	
    63	```bash
    64	uv run pytest
    65	npm test
    66	npm run build
    67	make check
    68	```
    69	
    70	自动测试使用 fake exchange、fixtures 或纯函数，不访问 Binance。公网 live smoke、模型分类 apply、账户、订单和交易动作不属于默认验证；需要时仍须单独授权。长期有用的验证结论可在任务完成后的异步 docs pass 中更新到 owning Feature。
    71	
    72	## 数据文件与排障
    73	
    74	- `config/instrument-groups.json`：repository-controlled group catalog。
    75	- `config/instrument-taxonomy.json`：Agent/base taxonomy；只由 structured apply 更新。
    76	- `config/instrument-taxonomy-overrides.json`：人工完整记录替换；优先级最高。
    77	- `config/monitor.json`：config v2；enabled groups 有序且最多 10，profiles 必须覆盖全部 catalog groups。
    78	- `data/runtime/selection.json`：筛选输出，原子替换；Strategy 只消费 ready v2。
    79	- `data/runtime/strategy_signals.json`：策略状态与有界事件，原子替换。
    80	- `data/runtime/symbol_details/<sha256>.json`：单标的已收盘 K 线和 SuperTrend 详情。
    81	
    82	Selection missing/v1/waiting 时，`/api/health` 报告 `waiting_for_selection_v2` 与 stale reason，Strategy 保留最后有效 snapshot 且不请求交易所。只有显式 public grouped screening 才能生成首份 ready selection v2；config migration 本身不会改写 selection。

    10	## 核心原则

    26	- 先找 owning module，再按仓库现有责任拆分；避免 numbered `part` 文件和无边界 `utils/common/helpers`。

    14	uv sync --dev
    15	npm install
    16	uv run trade-monitor serve
    17	npm run dev
    18	```
    19	
    20	本地 API 默认 `http://127.0.0.1:8787`，Vite 默认 `http://127.0.0.1:5173`。`serve` 启动后立即执行一次 public screening，之后每 4h 重跑；Strategy 每 60s 读取 selection v2 并轮询 15m REST K 线。
    21	
    22	只读检查现有 local artifacts 时使用无后台模式；它不会启动 screening/Strategy loops：

    35	## Config Migration
    36	
    37	```bash
    38	uv run trade-monitor config-migrate
    39	uv run trade-monitor config-rollback
    40	```
    41	
    42	Migration 首次运行会 exclusive-create `config/monitor.v1.backup.json` 和 `config/monitor.v1.backup.manifest.json`，重读校验 source bytes/digest/length 后才原子替换 active config。重复 migration 只校验既有 pair；路径、schema、digest、length 或 partial pair 冲突会停止。
    43	
    44	Rollback 同样要求 backup/manifest/active target 全部匹配，先 exclusive-create v2 rollback copy/manifest，再恢复 v1 bytes。Rollback 后当前 v2 binary 不能启动，不是日常切换命令。
    45	
    46	## Taxonomy Classifier
    47	
    48	显式入口是 repo-local `classify-binance-contracts` Pi skill。它只编排 structured CLI，不直接写 authority JSON：
    49	
    50	```bash
    51	uv run trade-monitor taxonomy snapshot --output /tmp/taxonomy-snapshot.json
    52	uv run trade-monitor taxonomy validate --draft /tmp/taxonomy-draft.json
    53	uv run trade-monitor taxonomy diff --draft /tmp/taxonomy-draft.json
    54	uv run trade-monitor taxonomy apply --draft /tmp/taxonomy-draft.json --expected-base-revision <sha256>
    55	```
    56	
    57	`snapshot` 是 public Binance/CCXT discovery，`apply` 是 authority mutation；两者都需要当前任务明确授权。`validate`/`diff` 是本地只读；`apply` 还要求 snapshot identity coverage、expected base revision 和 preserve-known/replace-unknown policy。Catalog 与 manual overrides 永不由 classifier 修改。
    58

    60	
    61	按改动风险选择最小充分集合，不要求每个任务运行全部命令或遵循固定测试顺序：
    62	
    63	```bash
    64	uv run pytest
    65	npm test
    66	npm run build
    67	make check
    68	```
    69	
    70	自动测试使用 fake exchange、fixtures 或纯函数，不访问 Binance。公网 live smoke、模型分类 apply、账户、订单和交易动作不属于默认验证；需要时仍须单独授权。长期有用的验证结论可在任务完成后的异步 docs pass 中更新到 owning Feature。
    71	
    72	## 数据文件与排障
    73	
    74	- `config/instrument-groups.json`：repository-controlled group catalog。
    75	- `config/instrument-taxonomy.json`：Agent/base taxonomy；只由 structured apply 更新。
    76	- `config/instrument-taxonomy-overrides.json`：人工完整记录替换；优先级最高。
    77	- `config/monitor.json`：config v2；enabled groups 有序且最多 10，profiles 必须覆盖全部 catalog groups。
    78	- `data/runtime/selection.json`：筛选输出，原子替换；Strategy 只消费 ready v2。
    79	- `data/runtime/strategy_signals.json`：策略状态与有界事件，原子替换。
    80	- `data/runtime/symbol_details/<sha256>.json`：单标的已收盘 K 线和 SuperTrend 详情。
    81	
    82	Selection missing/v1/waiting 时，`/api/health` 报告 `waiting_for_selection_v2` 与 stale reason，Strategy 保留最后有效 snapshot 且不请求交易所。只有显式 public grouped screening 才能生成首份 ready selection v2；config migration 本身不会改写 selection。

    22	- `screening.py` 持有第一部分筛选语义并只写原子 `selection.json`。
    23	- `strategy_monitor.py` 只通过 `selection.json` 获取标的，写 `strategy_signals.json` 与 `symbol_details/*.json`；禁止调用 screening 对象。
    24	- `api.py` 是 loopback 装配与只读/本地配置边界，不持有领域状态；`apps/web` 只通过本地 HTTP API 观测和调试。
    25	- MVP 不引入 Redis、数据库、消息队列、用户认证、账户或订单能力；JSON storage adapter 的未来替换不得改变合同语义。
    26	- 先找 owning module，再按仓库现有责任拆分；避免 numbered `part` 文件和无边界 `utils/common/helpers`。
    27	- 只有文件大小或混合职责确实妨碍安全修改时才使用 `.agents/skills/refactor-large-modules`，不以固定行数自动触发。
    28	
    29	## 文档读取
    30	
    31	按 `AGENTS.md -> docs/OVERVIEW.md -> feature/reference INDEX -> 1-3 份任务相关文档` 逐层读取，禁止全量读取 `docs/`。
    32	
    33	- Feature 的目标、边界、当前行为和简洁状态优先看 owning README。
    34	- 稳定架构、JSON 协议、运行和验证方式从 `docs/reference/` 进入。
    35	- 现有 requirements、ADR、changelog 或历史文档可以按任务读取，但不是普通实现的前置门禁，也不要求新增同类文件。
    36	- 新 idea 使用 `.agents/skills/add-idea`；只有 outcome、Feature owner 或安全/授权/兼容硬边界不清时才问一个核心问题。
    37	- 当前监控状态查看 `docs/feature/monitoring-mvp/README.md`；外部来源从 `docs/collaboration/` 按需进入，历史材料默认不读。
    38	
    39	## 轻量实施流程
    40	
    41	1. 读取项目规则、最多 1-3 份相关 docs 和当前代码入口。
    42	2. 只有目标或交易、网络、计费、敏感数据、兼容等硬边界无法判断时才询问用户；可逆实现细节沿用仓库惯例。
    43	3. 在声明边界内实施，保留无关修改，不制造新的流程控制层。
    44	4. 运行聚焦验证，再按实际影响范围运行更广检查；harness 不要求测试先行。
    45	5. 实现和验证完成后，主 Agent 异步委派一个 docs SubAgent，并提供最终行为摘要、修改文件、验证结果和候选文档 owner。
    46	6. 该 SubAgent 是这一轮唯一 docs writer，只做一轮增量 patch；主 Agent 不等待，也不并发修改同一批 docs。
    47	7. 没有长期文档影响时不改 docs；只有导航变化时才更新 INDEX/OVERVIEW。环境没有 SubAgent 时，主 Agent 才在结束阶段做一次轻量 fallback。
    48	
    49	文档本身是用户要求的主交付物，或文档状态会影响任务正确性时，可以同步完成；这不属于附属维护。
    50	
    51	## 项目内置 Skills
    52	
    53	- `.agents/skills/add-idea`：查找 Feature owner，只澄清最高优先级核心未知项，并一次更新最小核心 docs。
    54	- `.agents/skills/document-organization-harness`：建立或简化最小 docs 地图。
    55	- `.agents/skills/progressive-disclosure-docs`：减少文档读取与维护成本。
    56	- `.agents/skills/project-analysis`：只有 shallow docs 和直接代码读取不足时才分析架构、数据流、路线或行为差异。
    57	- `.agents/skills/project-docs-workflow`：完成实现与验证后发起一次异步 docs handoff。
    58	- `.agents/skills/external-collaboration-workflow`：按需保存外部来源和简洁采纳记录，不建立平行进度系统。
    59	- `.agents/skills/refactor-large-modules`：按稳定责任增量拆分真正过大或混合职责模块。
    60	
    61	## 委派与 Worktree
    62	
    63	- 普通 docs 维护默认使用完成后的单个异步 SubAgent；代码委派、并行开发或 worktree 仍需符合用户授权和工具边界。
    64	- 多个 writer 不得修改同一文件；重叠修改必须串行或使用隔离 worktree。
    65	- 不得为获得干净状态而丢弃无关修改。
    66	- 任何委派都不会自动授权公网 live、账户、交易、计费或敏感数据访问。
    67	
    68	## 测试与验证
    69	
    70	- 新增或修改行为时维护有价值的对应测试，但不要求固定 TDD 顺序。
    71	- 先运行相关聚焦检查，再按影响范围运行 `make check`。
    72	- 自动测试默认使用 fake exchange 或纯函数；Binance 公共 REST live smoke 仅在任务需要且边界允许时启用。
    73	- 纯 docs 主任务至少检查相关链接、真实 skill 路径和占位符。
    74	
    75	## 长期边界
    76	
    77	- 模板不得保留 demo 项目名、占位符或不存在路径。
    78	- 外部 proposal 只提供 provenance/recommendation，不能覆盖内部安全边界或自动授权实施。
    79	- 会话计划、中间分析、原始工具输出和逐文件进度不进入长期 docs。
    80	- 详情页面和 API 不得绕过 Strategy JSON 产物临时直连 Binance，否则会破坏 closed-bar 与调试一致性。
    81	<!-- HARNESS-GOVERNANCE:END -->

   171	    for raw_line in match.group(1).splitlines():

   174	            continue

   148	def parse_frontmatter(text: str) -> dict[str, str]:
   149	    match = FRONTMATTER_RE.match(text)

   157	            continue
   158	        key, value = line.split(":", 1)
   159	        metadata[key.strip()] = value.strip().strip('"').strip("'")

1	# FreqAI Historical Research Contract
     2	
     3	> Project context entry point: [`docs/OVERVIEW.md`](docs/OVERVIEW.md)
     4	
     5	This repository is the Freqtrade/FreqAI runtime shell for local historical model and strategy research. It is not a
     6	trading-execution environment. Use Chinese for user-facing conversation; keep internal working notes in English.
     7	
     8	## Safety And Authorization
     9	
    10	- Development priority, code presence, configuration, or experiment results never authorize training, holdout access,
    11	  dry-run, shadow, live trading, force entries, orders, or execution.
    12	- Do not modify Freqtrade core behavior, builtin templates, builtin model sources, or `/Users/shancw/workspace/lightgbm`
    13	  from this workflow unless explicitly approved.
    14	- Keep project work under `user_data/`, `docs/`, `tests/`, or `scripts/`; copy variants rather than editing upstream examples.
    15	- Never write secrets, credentials, account IDs, exchange keys, or private runtime data.
    16	- Do not use leverage, position sizing, reduced costs, future leakage, or post-hoc side removal to rescue negative expectancy.
    17	- Treat rejected weights, closed thresholds, caches, sealed holdout, and archived evidence as read-only.
    18	
    19	## Lightweight Harness
    20	
    21	- Current code owns implemented behavior; user direction and this file own outcome and authorization.
    22	- Read docs progressively: `AGENTS.md -> docs/OVERVIEW.md -> owning INDEX/README -> 1-3 relevant leaves`.
    23	- Do not bulk-read `docs/` or create requirements, Specs, ADRs, task boards, route manifests, status matrices, or progress
    24	  logs as a normal implementation start gate.
    25	- Existing research contracts, requirements, changelogs, decisions, and evidence remain valid project records and may be
    26	  read when relevant; this upgrade does not delete or rewrite them.
    27	- The harness does not prescribe TDD, testing-first, fixed validation matrices, fixed file-size gates, or lifecycle state machines.
    28	- Ask the user only when outcome, research authorization, safety, evidence meaning, or an irreversible boundary is unclear.
    29	
    30	## Active Research Navigation
    31	
    32	- Resolve the current Feature from [`docs/OVERVIEW.md`](docs/OVERVIEW.md), then enter its owning INDEX/README.
    33	- Separate planned research stays separate until the user changes the project-level focus.
    34	- Closed research is read through [`docs/archive/INDEX.md`](docs/archive/INDEX.md) only when historical evidence is needed.
    35	- External handoffs use [`docs/collaboration/INDEX.md`](docs/collaboration/INDEX.md) only when durable provenance is actually needed.
    36	- Current-turn order stays in the session plan. Persist a route only when a cross-session dependency genuinely changes;
    37	  use readable semantic names rather than machine node IDs.
    38	- `.agents/tasks/archive/` and existing taskBoards are historical evidence, not the default active control plane.
    39	
    40	## Code Ownership
    41	
    42	- Keep CLI, strategy, FreqAI model, and runner entrypoints thin; domain logic, I/O, state, accounting, validation, and
    43	  reporting need clear owners and acyclic dependencies.
    44	- Search for the existing owner before creating modules. Avoid numbered `part` files and unbounded `utils/common` modules.
    45	- Use `.agents/skills/harness/refactor-large-modules` only when size or mixed responsibility actually blocks safe change,
    46	  not from an automatic line threshold.
    47	- Follow [`docs/reference/code-organization.md`](docs/reference/code-organization.md) where its project-specific architecture
    48	  applies; it does not require pre-implementation docs writes.
    49	
    50	## Implementation And Async Docs Handoff
    51	
    52	1. Read project rules, at most 1-3 relevant docs, and current code entrypoints.
    53	2. Confirm the action stays inside research, data, safety, and authorization boundaries; use repository defaults for reversible details.
    54	3. Implement within the owning module and preserve unrelated changes/artifacts.
    55	4. Run focused validation, then broader checks justified by the actual impact; no fixed test order is required.
    56	5. After implementation and validation complete, the main Agent launches one asynchronous docs SubAgent with the final
    57	   behavior summary, changed files, validation results, and candidate docs owners.
    58	6. That SubAgent is the only docs writer for the pass and makes one incremental patch. The main Agent does not wait or
    59	   modify the same docs concurrently.
    60	7. If no durable fact changed, do not update docs. If no SubAgent is available, the main Agent performs one lightweight
    61	   fallback pass at the end.
    62	
    63	Docs are handled synchronously only when documentation itself is the requested deliverable or its state is required for correctness.
    64	
    65	## Repo-local Skills
    66	
    67	- `.agents/skills/review-rl-training`: multi-axis RL training evidence review.
    68	- `.agents/skills/diagnose-rl-underfitting`: falsifiable low-return/underfitting diagnosis.
    69	- `.agents/skills/freqai-rl-development`: historical FreqAI RL design and validation.
    70	- `.agents/skills/harness/add-idea`: find the Feature owner and ask only the highest-impact unresolved boundary question.
    71	- `.agents/skills/harness/document-organization-harness`: create or simplify a minimal docs map.
    72	- `.agents/skills/harness/project-docs-workflow`: completion-time asynchronous docs handoff.
    73	- `.agents/skills/harness/project-analysis`: focused architecture, dataflow, RCA, route, and behavior-gap analysis.
    74	- `.agents/skills/harness/external-collaboration-workflow`: optional external source and adoption provenance.
    75	- `.agents/skills/harness/progressive-disclosure-docs`: lightweight docs navigation and ownership.
    76	- `.agents/skills/harness/refactor-large-modules`: incremental responsibility-based extraction.
    77	- `.agents/skills/harness/et-home-research-runner`: explicitly authorized `et-home-server` historical training workflow.
    78	
    79	Load only skills matching the task. The presence of a skill never grants execution or research authorization.
    80	
    81	## Historical Research Guardrails
    82	
    83	- Read [`docs/reference/historical-research-rules.md`](docs/reference/historical-research-rules.md) plus the relevant active
    84	  research record before an experiment or research-code change.
    85	- Freeze comparison geometry and costs for an authorized run; change one declared experimental axis per run.
    86	- Use a new `freqai.identifier` for every independent run. Cache flags do not replace identifier isolation.
    87	- Never train transforms on prediction/holdout data or select thresholds/checkpoints from outer OOS or sealed holdout.
    88	- Report coverage, concentration, independent episodes, gross/net expectancy, costs, PF, drawdown, cost stress, and same-window baselines.
    89	- For authorized `et-home-server` training, use `scripts/et_home_research.py`; `submit --check-only` never starts training.
    90	- Historical, engineering, discovery, validation, and execution evidence remain distinct.
    91	
    92	## Delegation And Change Safety
    93	
    94	- One asynchronous docs SubAgent is the default completion-time maintenance path requested by project policy.
    95	- Code/research delegation, parallel implementation, training, and worktrees still require normal user/tool authorization.
    96	- Use one writer per overlapping file set. Preserve unrelated edits, runtime artifacts, branches, and evidence.
    97	- Do not commit, push, force-push, or modify remotes unless explicitly requested.
    98	
    99	## Validation
   100	
   101	- Python: targeted `pytest`; broader `pytest`, Ruff, mypy, or `pre-commit run -a` only when justified by shared impact.
   102	- Research docs: `python3 scripts/validate_research_docs.py` and `bash tests/test_docs.sh` when those docs are the deliverable.
   103	- Code structure: `python3 scripts/validate_code_organization.py` when module ownership changed.
   104	- Public docs/navigation: relevant link checks and `mkdocs build --strict` when MkDocs content changed.
   105	- Run every lineage, leakage, cost, accounting, artifact, and evidence validator required by the actual research operation.

   170	        return

   195	            continue

   198	            errors.append(f"route edge {source!r}->{target!r} has unknown node in {relative}")
   199	            continue

   202	            continue

- **Note**: collaboration 模板兼容修复有效。无 frontmatter 的 case INDEX 走 visible-field 路径，source 文件只要求 INDEX backlink：[freqtrade validator](/Users/shancw/workspace/freqtrade/scripts/validate_research_docs.py:473)、[source validation](/Users/shancw/workspace/freqtrade/scripts/validate_research_docs.py:517)；worktree 对应逻辑位于 [validator](/Users/shancw/workspace/freqtrade-wt-regime-engineering/scripts/validate_research_docs.py:414)。两处只读模板探针均返回 `[]`。

- **Correct**: active route manifest 已不再强制。freqtrade 调用 `validate_route_manifest(..., False, ...)`：[validate_research_docs.py](/Users/shancw/workspace/freqtrade/scripts/validate_research_docs.py:286)，缺失 manifest 在 `required == False` 时直接接受：[research_docs_route_contract.py](/Users/shancw/workspace/freqtrade/scripts/research_docs_route_contract.py:361)。worktree Feature 循环已不再调用 route validator：[validate_research_docs.py](/Users/shancw/workspace/freqtrade-wt-regime-engineering/scripts/validate_research_docs.py:253)。

- **Correct**: 两个 `bash tests/test_docs.sh` 均通过。freqtrade 运行 8 个 route-contract tests，并报告 research docs `152 files / 1 warning`、code organization `365 changed code files / 0 warnings`；worktree 报告 `50 files / 1 warning`、`34 changed code files / 0 warnings`。共同 warning 是既有 675 行 alignment 文档，与本次 finding 无关。

## Review

- **Blocker (High)**: 轻量 Feature 模板与两个 research docs validator 仍不兼容。模板 README 从首行开始没有 frontmatter：[freqtrade template](/Users/shancw/workspace/freqtrade/.agents/skills/harness/progressive-disclosure-docs/assets/feature-template/README.md:1)、[worktree template](/Users/shancw/workspace/freqtrade-wt-regime-engineering/.agents/skills/harness/progressive-disclosure-docs/assets/feature-template/README.md:1)；但 validator 仍无条件要求 9 个旧 metadata 字段，并对每个 Feature 调用该检查：[freqtrade validator](/Users/shancw/workspace/freqtrade/scripts/validate_research_docs.py:202)、[freqtrade call site](/Users/shancw/workspace/freqtrade/scripts/validate_research_docs.py:281)、[worktree validator](/Users/shancw/workspace/freqtrade-wt-regime-engineering/scripts/validate_research_docs.py:185)、[worktree call site](/Users/shancw/workspace/freqtrade-wt-regime-engineering/scripts/validate_research_docs.py:263)。只读探针在两处均返回 `owner metadata missing ... authorization, evidence_status, last_verified, lifecycle, module, next_gate, role, status, type`。因此现有树测试虽通过，从轻量模板创建的新 Feature 仍会失败。

- **Note**: collaboration 模板兼容修复有效。无 frontmatter 的 case INDEX 走 visible-field 路径，source 文件只要求 INDEX backlink：[freqtrade validator](/Users/shancw/workspace/freqtrade/scripts/validate_research_docs.py:473)、[source validation](/Users/shancw/workspace/freqtrade/scripts/validate_research_docs.py:517)；worktree 对应逻辑位于 [validator](/Users/shancw/workspace/freqtrade-wt-regime-engineering/scripts/validate_research_docs.py:414)。两处只读模板探针均返回 `[]`。

- **Correct**: active route manifest 已不再强制。freqtrade 调用 `validate_route_manifest(..., False, ...)`：[validate_research_docs.py](/Users/shancw/workspace/freqtrade/scripts/validate_research_docs.py:286)，缺失 manifest 在 `required == False` 时直接接受：[research_docs_route_contract.py](/Users/shancw/workspace/freqtrade/scripts/research_docs_route_contract.py:361)。worktree Feature 循环已不再调用 route validator：[validate_research_docs.py](/Users/shancw/workspace/freqtrade-wt-regime-engineering/scripts/validate_research_docs.py:253)。

- **Correct**: 两个 `bash tests/test_docs.sh` 均通过。freqtrade 运行 8 个 route-contract tests，并报告 research docs `152 files / 1 warning`、code organization `365 changed code files / 0 warnings`；worktree 报告 `50 files / 1 warning`、`34 changed code files / 0 warnings`。共同 warning 是既有 675 行 alignment 文档，与本次 finding 无关。
